title: Hierarchical Planning H5: Home's build makes the plan and applies it before the first stage
request: The owner's yes to: let Home's build make and follow the plan before its stages run. Until now a project built from Home ran its five stages with no plan; the path was drawn afterwards, for display, with a warning when the model had not followed it.
spec: Build project itself stays as it is (its route, button, handler and function are pinned by a test). Code owns the split and what is kept out; nothing a person decided is overridden; nothing is changed once a stage has run; a model's plan is made in a job, never in a web request.
plan: one entry, tasks/path.py plan_project: the plan, its catches as stricter solution changes through the validated move, the plan kept on the project with what was done
Home's build it: the rules' plan right after the project is made (instant, no model), said in the build's message
the build's own stages job: the model's plan with room, before the first stage, when the workspace allows model plans and the project is not private
the project page shows the kept plan, its open questions and whether what was built follows it

decisions.decision: Nobody is in the room when this runs, so only what code itself confirms is applied; the rest is a question
decisions.why: the review: a model's word alone had set the split on a column that is not a time, and a catch about a related table's column had kept out a different column of the main table

decisions.decision: A solution the person wrote or signed is never changed, and a column the person said is known beforehand stays in, in the model's later plan too
decisions.why: the review: only a signature counted as the person's word, so an answer given seconds earlier was overridden

decisions.decision: Only the build's own job plans first
decisions.why: the review: the hook ran on every intern session, also one a person starts on a project they configured by hand; the owner approved it for Home's build

decisions.decision: The model is asked outside the project's lock, and its plan is dropped if the solution changed meanwhile
decisions.why: its answer takes minutes; every write to the project would have waited, and the person's edit would have been overwritten

decisions.decision: A project of several parts, a solution map or a kind with no outcome column is left alone
decisions.why: the rules' plan and its checks are about one table and one outcome

change: New dclab_rnd/tasks/path.py; quick_build in draft/api.py (after the pinned build), the build message in draft/chat.py, jobs/handlers.py (_plan_first, plan_first in the job's payload), tasks/view.py (the kept plan, settled questions), tasks/dispatch.py (change_solution as a function), tasks/catalog.py (rules_plan), the project page's text, CLAUDE.md.

findings.defect: A catch about a related table's column was applied to a different column of the main table.
findings.scenario: The main table has status and amount; a related table has closed_status and final_amount. The rules caught the related table's two columns, and the main table's status and amount were kept out: neither had been caught.
findings.cause: a trap is read by the column its name ends with, which was fine for reading whether a plan was obeyed and wrong for driving a change
findings.fix: a column is kept out only when a check of the plan is on that very column of the main table and code found it; a catch with no such check is neither a change nor a question

findings.defect: A model's plan set the split on any column it named.
findings.scenario: The model's plan checks a time split on tenure: the time column became tenure, so the holdout was the longest-tenure customers; a group on a column of three values made whole groups the holdout.
findings.cause: a named column was only checked to exist
findings.fix: a split by time only on a column code reads as a time, a group only on a column code reads as an entity (many distinct values that repeat); otherwise the person is asked

findings.defect: The plan overrode what the person had just decided, and ran on every intern session.
findings.scenario: The person answers that a column is known at the prediction moment, so it stays a feature; seconds later the plan kept it out by its name. A person starts an intern session on a project they wrote by hand: the plan changed their solution and said nothing.
findings.cause: only a signature counted as the person's word, and the hook was in the handler of every intern run
findings.fix: a solution saved by a person is only ever asked about; the person's kept columns are passed to the plan and recorded as their decision; the hook runs only when the build's own job says so

findings.defect: The project's lock was held while the model thought, for minutes.
findings.scenario: The person saves the solution while the model plans: the save waits, or is overwritten by the plan's changes.
findings.cause: the model request was inside the project's turn
findings.fix: the project is read under the lock, the model asked outside it, and the plan applied under the lock only if the solution and the stages are as they were

findings.defect: After the first review fix a question about the wrong column still reached the person.
findings.scenario: When the plan had kept out as many columns as it may, the next catch became a question before the check that it was about this column at all.
findings.cause: the question path ran before the confirmation
findings.fix: the confirmation comes first, for a change and for a question alike

findings.defect: A question the person had settled on the solution's page stayed open on the plan.
findings.scenario: The plan asks about a column; the person keeps it out by hand; the page still said the question waited for them.
findings.cause: the kept questions were never read again against the solution
findings.fix: the page drops a question the solution now answers

findings.defect: On a real Home build the stages never ran: the agent's session failed at its first request because the provider refused the key.
findings.scenario: The person says build it and is told 'Building now'; the model's key is refused; the session ends as failed with no stage run. With no model configured the fixed plan runs; with a model that cannot be reached, nothing did.
findings.cause: the fall-back to the fixed plan looked only at whether a model is configured
findings.fix: a model that cannot be reached at all, before anything was done, gives way to the fixed plan, which says why; a failure after work began is still a failure

findings.defect: After a real build the page drew five finished stages as 'blocked', read a split by the time column as not by time, showed an open question as a broken plan, and named a tool as the next step.
findings.scenario: A project built from Home with no model: split 'last 120 of 600 rows by signup_date', one catch waiting for the person's answer.
findings.cause: the preview graph's states overrode the project's own stages; the time check looked for the word time; a question and a violation were counted alike
findings.fix: the project's stages say what ran; a split ordered by the solution's time column is by time; an unconfirmed suspicion is a question, a confirmed catch the person must apply stays not followed; the next step shows the question itself

measurements.name: One Home build on the real server, end to end (no model: the provider refused the key)
measurements.gate: none: a walk of the real flow on an invented table of 600 rows with one planted leak
measurements.result: the build's message carried the plan's note; the plan was kept on the project with four steps; the audit had already kept the leak out and set the time column, so the plan applied nothing more and asked one question (a snapshot column); after the fall-back fix all five stages ran, split by time; the page showed the path, the stages as done, the plan as followed and the question as open
measurements.next: the same build with a working model key, to see the model's plan made in the job
limits: no model answered: the model's plan in the stages job was not exercised live
the first build's session failed before the fix and is kept in the run's folder

measurements.name: One Home build on the real server with a live model (Qwen 3.8 flash), end to end
measurements.gate: none: a walk of the real flow on the same invented table
measurements.result: the rules' plan was made at the build; in the stages job the model planned with room (two requests, 183 and 185 seconds, EUR 0.018) and its plan replaced the rules' before the first stage: three sub-problems in order (what one row is; then the late columns, and how rare churn is), six steps, the planted leak caught; it applied nothing because the audit had already kept the leak out and set the split by time; the live agent then ran the five stages: holdout ROC-AUC 0.711 (95% interval 0.586 to 0.821, 120 rows), the leak kept out, the holdout read once; EUR 0.078 for the whole run; 59 exchanges, every one with its thinking kept (31 redacted, as they saw table values)
measurements.next: the lead agent's two slips, and a held-out set before any claim
limits: the model's plan did not raise lifetime_orders, which the rules asked about: the two plans disagree on one column
the lead agent lost the prediction moment between messages and saved 'Build it now' as part of it

outcome: A project built from Home's build it gets its plan before its first stage: what code confirms is applied and said in the build's message, the rest is a question on the project's page. Walked once on the real server with no model (the provider refused the key): the plan, the build message, the stages and the page all held after two fixes the walk itself found. The model's plan in the stages job has not run live. A project built with the wizard and started by hand still gets no plan, by design: its solution is the person's. Then walked with a live model: the model's plan was made in the stages job and replaced the rules' plan before the first stage; the stages ran under the live agent.
lessons: A helper that was safe for reading (which column does this trap name) is not safe for writing: driving a change needs an exact match.
When no person is in the loop, a model's word must be confirmed by code before it changes anything.
An approval for one flow is not an approval for every flow that shares its handler.
risks: The model's plan adds minutes before the first stage of a Home build when model plans are switched on.

A column is kept out only when its name is one the product's own leakage audit keeps out; an honest column with such a name stays out until the person puts it back, after which it is never touched again.
No live run of Home's build with the plan yet; the gate hp_gate_v1 is still not run.
